description.narrative: UPLIFT DC is a project that supports the peaceful reintegration of Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) decommissioned combatants (DCs) and their families into civilian life. The project aims to strengthen information and case management systems, improve access to government services, and create sustainable livelihood opportunities for former combatants and vulnerable groups, including women.The project will establish a Management Information System (MIS) to help government agencies and peace mechanisms track, manage, and monitor services provided to more than 26,000 decommissioned combatants. It will also develop standardized case management guidelines, protocols and strengthen the skills of social case managers to ensure that DCs receive timely and appropriate support.In addition, the project will provide training, livelihood assistance, and cooperative development support to selected male and female DCs and their families to help increase income and improve their quality of life. Through effective project management, monitoring, and partnership with government agencies, the project seeks to promote sustainable livelihoods, social inclusion, and lasting peace in the Bangsamoro region.
